confirmation.feedback: After keeps repair, immutable, raw-ac and no-op intact (diff plus gate, one attributed sketch line, full 300-word Idea and the 418-line inventory sentence verbatim in a new comment, explicit pre-gate raw AC PASS, CSV-export definition dropped and deliveryMux definition conditioned on absent reporter attribution). The regression is on invalid: Before states the wishful criterion 'blocks the entire repair run' with neither body nor comment eligible for writing, whereas After scopes the stop to 'this branch' and closes with 'Original ticket: awaiting approval; not written. Invalid-criterion branch: stopped.', leaving the original repair still approvable — a local stop, not the run-wide singleton integrity stop the fact requires. The Change's 'keep hard stops local' was meant for batch processing across tickets; the wording should say that in a single-ticket run (including repair-overflow/invalid) a wishful criterion on any branch halts the entire run and withdraws approval options, while in batch mode a stop on one ticket only blocks that ticket and later tickets proceed. Keeping that distinction explicit would deliver the batch-repair/stop-local move without moving this fact.
